intents.title: Build the Competency Compiler on the real GREG path
intents.statement: The intended engineering result is a Competency Compiler: GREG recognizes a problem, determines which epistemic methods can answer it, recruits the smallest competent mechanism or composition, produces appropriately typed evidence, respects authority, observes outcomes, and improves future selection.
intents.source: founder directive, Claude Code session session_01FUAZEkNuHx7ktktUGT2tw2
intents.intended_outcome: cognition.solve routes a problem by geometry and hard eligibility to typed, verified computation inside signed missions, and settles competence from appraised outcomes
intents.rationale: Seed delivered and integrated; whether routing beats simpler routing is SG-006
intents.owner: Alfonso Lopez (root authority); cortex and GREG maintainers implement
intents.next_review_trigger: a new frozen comparison or P4 exit

intents.title: Preserve the founder's goal-set words and compile them to engineering
intents.statement: Translate "meniscus" and "surface tension" into the strongest defensible operating frontier within a verified permission, rights, safety, resource, and evidence envelope.
intents.source: founder directive, Claude Code session session_01FUAZEkNuHx7ktktUGT2tw2
intents.intended_outcome: Operate at the frontier of the verified envelope with margins for uncertainty and tail risk; layered prevention, bounded failure, independent verification and recoverability in place of an 'impermeable shield'; superior lawful capability in place of 'systemic dominance'
intents.rationale: The quotations stay verbatim in the source file; the translations are the executable reading
intents.owner: Alfonso Lopez (root authority); cortex and GREG maintainers implement
intents.next_review_trigger: any request to widen the envelope

intents.title: No control over people, no resistance to shutdown, no promise of perfection
intents.statement: Neither phrase licenses control over people, resistance to shutdown, or promises of perfection.
intents.source: founder directive, Claude Code session session_01FUAZEkNuHx7ktktUGT2tw2
intents.intended_outcome: These readings are refused by construction: cognition creates no authority, founder stop wins, receipts never claim certainty beyond their proof class
intents.rationale: Directive section 0 states the limit explicitly
intents.owner: Alfonso Lopez (root authority); cortex and GREG maintainers implement

intents.title: Deliver the four-class seed with an independent verifier
intents.statement: The later four-competency seed governs this build: Semantic, Estimation, Formal/Optimization, Evidence/Causal, plus an independent verifier.
intents.source: founder directive, Claude Code session session_01FUAZEkNuHx7ktktUGT2tw2
intents.intended_outcome: Each class runs with its declared scope; Formal and Optimization keep separate method IDs and proof classes
intents.rationale: The semantic class abstains here: no founder-selected local model is reachable
intents.owner: Alfonso Lopez (root authority); cortex and GREG maintainers implement
intents.next_review_trigger: a founder-selected local model becomes reachable

intents.title: Freeze the evaluation before optimizing to it
intents.statement: Define normalized per-task loss before observing candidate results.
intents.source: founder directive, Claude Code session session_01FUAZEkNuHx7ktktUGT2tw2
intents.intended_outcome: Loss, suites, arms, decision rule and sample-size plan frozen and committed before any held-out run
intents.rationale: The freeze commit precedes the results commit in git history
intents.owner: Alfonso Lopez (root authority); cortex and GREG maintainers implement
intents.next_review_trigger: any change to a frozen input

intents.title: Verified Cross-Geometry Routing Gain
intents.statement: The cognition bottleneck is Verified Cross-Geometry Routing Gain.
intents.source: founder directive, Claude Code session session_01FUAZEkNuHx7ktktUGT2tw2
intents.intended_outcome: Frozen verdict: GAIN_VERIFIED_AGAINST_RUN_BASELINES. Against the static router (strongest baseline that ran) on 1,200 fresh held-out items: paired gain 0.0064 (95% CI 0.0044-0.0084), 25.6% relative reduction, zero hard failures. About all of it comes from incomparable option trade-offs handed to the founder; elsewhere the routed system ties or trails by worker latency. v0.2 was GAIN_ABSENT on one hard failure, fixed in 0.2.1. The model arms did not run.
intents.rationale: Seed completeness and superiority are separate claims; the model baselines could not run here
intents.owner: Alfonso Lopez (root authority); cortex and GREG maintainers implement
intents.next_review_trigger: a founder-selected local model makes the model arms runnable, or P4 learned routing is ready
unresolved_questions: Does the cortex beat an always-LLM and a tool-enabled model workflow on the same suite?

intents.title: No merge, deployment, contact, publication, paid service or live-authority change

intents.owner: Alfonso Lopez (root authority); cortex and GREG maintainers implement

intents.title: Should high privacy harm be a hard gate?
intents.statement: Preserve truth, privacy, consent, human agency, appeal, correction, and participant welfare.
intents.source: founder directive, Claude Code session session_01FUAZEkNuHx7ktktUGT2tw2
intents.intended_outcome: A founder ruling on whether options with high privacy harm are excluded before ranking (today: ranked, not excluded, unless critical)
intents.rationale: The declared harm policy (cortex HARD_HARM_DIMENSIONS) excludes privacy; the evaluation follows the declared policy rather than silently changing a gate
intents.owner: Alfonso Lopez (root authority); cortex and GREG maintainers implement
unresolved_questions: Add 'privacy' to HARD_HARM_DIMENSIONS, or keep privacy harm rankable below critical?
